A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Dynamic-LLaVA and contain complete main texts and appendices A.1–A.6. Their equations, tables, and figures support reliable comparison; rendering resolves extraction ambiguities in dense tables.

before.justification: v1 reports original vision-understanding and generation evaluations, inference measurements, ablations, and qualitative examples in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experiments and appendix analyses, with two revised inference-time measurements in Table 4.

M1.justification: The two predictors, stage-specific sparsification procedures, MaskedSoftmax training, Gumbel-Softmax estimator, regularization, and appendix batch-inference procedure remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both retain the 656K instruction-tuning dataset, vision-understanding benchmarks, single- and multi-round LVIS-VQA, ShareGPT4V-VQA, and COCO visualizations. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged across corresponding tables, including FastV, PruMerge+, H2O, projector baselines, Random/Structure, and the appendix IVTP, TRIM, and SparseVLM comparisons.

E3.justification: Model sizes, training budgets, benchmark construction, metrics, and testing procedures are retained. Table 4 still specifies one A100 (80G) and batch size 8; its revised timings have no accompanying setting change.

E4.justification: Both contain the same keep-rate and hyperparameter ablations, MaskedSoftmax analysis, prefill-text pruning experiment, appendix trade-offs, and qualitative examples. Reflow does not add or remove analyses.

E5.justification: Both report point estimates and benchmark averages without repeated-run counts, seeds, error bars, confidence intervals, or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Table 4 changes Dynamic-LLaVA-13B I|T decoding times without KV cache at 2K and 4K output tokens from 2682 and 8184 seconds to 2382 and 6184 seconds under unchanged stated settings. Other results and rankings remain unchanged. Neither PDF explains whether these revisions reflect corrections or reruns.

T1.justification: Equations 1–13, token-set definitions, training mathematics, batch-inference derivations in A.1, and the FLOPs calculation in A.4.5 are retained. No mathematical assumption, proof, or formal result is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and efficiency claims: simultaneous vision-language sparsification, tailored inference modes, approximately 75% prefill computation savings, and approximately 50% decoding computation or memory savings with negligible degradation.

C2.justification: Interpretations of diminishing vision-only savings, H2O's multimodal performance, sparsity trade-offs, and the limitations of pruning prefill text remain unchanged. The added graph-compression analogy concerns related-work positioning rather than a new interpretation of the experiments.

D1.justification: Predictor architecture details, learning rates, batch sizes, hardware, training times, benchmark-selection instructions, and code-access information are unchanged. Several appendix passages move across page boundaries without changing their content.

R1.justification: A.3.2 adds a brief connection to GraRep, low-dimensional graph embeddings, and graph-sparsity image-token compression. Both new citations render as question marks, with no corresponding bibliography additions. The established positioning against token-reduction and KV-cache methods remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v4 updates author and affiliation information, replaces the preprint header with ICLR 2025 publication information, adds acknowledgments, and lightly condenses experimental-setting and caption wording. The scientific narrative and section ordering remain largely intact.

P2.justification: Tables 3 and 5 are reduced in size, changing surrounding text wrapping and page composition. Captions and appendix pagination receive limited adjustments. All 17 tables and eight figures are retained, with unchanged figure content.

improvement.justification: v4 completes publication and acknowledgment information, but introduces unresolved citations in A.3.2 and shrinks already dense Tables 3 and 5, weakening traceability and readability. The scientific validation is otherwise retained; unexplained lower Table 4 timings do not establish improved study quality. The net decline is limited.
